Perks › Common

Even Flow

Common perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, a bone with an even pip total adds 5 points.

In-game card text

How it works

When your scoring play uses a bone whose two halves add up to an even number (every double, plus bones such as 1-3 or 2-6), the play gains +5 points for each copy.

  • The double blank (0 pips) counts as even.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 120 Bone Bucks.
